Author: the Puni.sh Quest Squad
Name: Questionable
Description:
A tiny little quest helper plugin, which does quests for you automatically where possible. Uses MappingTheRealm to travel to every quest objective, and tries to automatically complete all steps along the way.

Not all quests are supported, check the quest journal (/qst journal) for an updated list.

If you agree, Questionable shares whether each quest path worked, so broken paths get fixed sooner. It asks first, and never sends your character name, account or IP address.

Required Plugins: vnavmesh, MappingTheRealm, TextAdvance
Recommended for combat: Boss Mod
